EmailTemplate.description: Fee waivers are not accepted for nondegree-seeking students.
EmailTemplate.name: Fee Waiver: Nondegree-seeking applicant
EmailTemplate.subject: We received your application fee waiver
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Admission Services recently received an application fee waiver for you from your school. However, you have applied to Arizona State University as a nondegree-seeking student (meaning you want to take a couple of classes, but are not planning on completing a degree). Waivers are not accepted for nondegree-seeking students, so if this status is correct, please submit your application fee through My ASU at http://my.asu.edu/.
If you do plan to attend ASU to receive a bachelor's degree:
1. Submit a new application as soon as possible at http://asu.edu/apply. 2. Select that you are a degree-seeking student and list a major to study. 3. When you are asked to pay your application fee, select the Pay Later option. 4. We will match your waiver with your application.
If you applied as nondegree-seeking because you have not decided on a major, please use our degree search (http://asu.edu/degrees) tool to find a major based on your favorite subject, career interests or keywords. If you are still undecided, you are welcome to list one of our exploratory programs as your degree interest on your application.
IMPORTANT: Once you have submitted your new application, cancel your nondegree-seeking application at http://students.asu.edu/canceladmissions.
Let me know if you have any additional questions about the admission process.
Sincerely,
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
{!Case.Thread_Id}
